proves.claim: block add names a block of two items with a tier and prints it, and block list prints one row per block with its name, tier and member ids.

cli.block.add-and-list.why: Without it a recorded block would have no command that creates it or shows it.

proves.claim: block add with one id or an unknown tier is refused USAGE naming the valid tiers and records no block.

cli.block.refusals.why: Without it a malformed block could reach the board through the command line.
